title: Electrophysiology Team-Administered Conscious Sedation for Pulsed-Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed-field ablation (PFA) is emerging as a novel nonthermal alternative. However, PFA is commonly performed under general anesthesia or deep sedation requiring anesthesiologists, which increases resource utilization and limits its widespread application. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of conscious sedation for PFA administered by the electrophysiology (EP) team, using radiofrequency ablation (RFA) as a comparator.

METHODS: A total of 120 patients with symptomatic, drug-refractory atrial fibrillation were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to the PFA group or the RFA group. We evaluated three key outcomes: (1) intraoperative patient tolerance, assessed using validated scales (Faces Pain Scale-Revised [FPS-R], Likert Scale Questionnaire [LSQ]) combined with intraoperative body movement and cough reactions; (2) procedural efficiency; and (3) procedural safety.

RESULTS: The incidence of pain during pulmonary vein isolation was comparable between the two groups (all p > 0.05), whereas FPS-R scores were significantly lower in the PFA group (p < 0.05). No significant difference was observed in movement scores between the two groups (p = 0.452). According to the LSQ analysis, only 1 patient (1.7%) in the RFA group reported dissatisfaction with intraoperative pain management. Cough incidence during PVI was higher with PFA (21.7% [13/60] vs 6.7% [4/60]; p = 0.018). Both total procedure time and left atrial dwell time were shorter in the PFA group. Furthermore, no serious complications were directly related to conscious sedation.

CONCLUSION: In selected low-risk patients, EP team-administered conscious sedation is feasible for PFA, with acceptable intraoperative tolerance and safety while preserving procedural efficiency.

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）正作为一种新型非热替代方案崭露头角。然而，PFA通常在全身麻醉或需要麻醉医师参与的深度镇静下进行，这增加了资源利用并限制了其广泛应用。本研究旨在评估由电生理（EP）团队实施清醒镇静用于PFA的可行性，并以射频消融（RFA）作为对照。

方法：共120例有症状、药物难治性心房颤动患者按1:1比例随机分配至PFA组或RFA组。我们评估了三个关键结局：（1）术中患者耐受性，采用经验证的量表（修订版面部疼痛量表[FPS-R]、Likert量表问卷[LSQ]）结合术中体动和咳嗽反应进行评估；（2）手术效率；（3）手术安全性。

结果：两组在肺静脉隔离期间的疼痛发生率相当（所有p > 0.05），而PFA组的FPS-R评分显著更低（p < 0.05）。两组间体动评分未观察到显著差异（p = 0.452）。根据LSQ分析，RFA组仅有1例患者（1.7%）报告对术中疼痛管理不满意。PVI期间咳嗽发生率在PFA组更高（21.7% [13/60] vs 6.7% [4/60]；p = 0.018）。PFA组的总手术时间和左心房停留时间均更短。此外，无严重并发症与清醒镇静直接相关。

结论：在选定的低风险患者中，由EP团队实施的清醒镇静用于PFA是可行的，术中耐受性和安全性可接受，同时保持了手术效率。

title: Potassium and Cardiovascular Disease.
summary: Hyperkalemia (potassium levels >5.5 mEq/L) or hypokalemia (potassium < 3.5 mEq/L) may incur potentially serious cardiovascular (CV) complications. Hyperkalemia is most commonly encountered in renal failure, K+ oversupplementation for diuretic therapy, use of potassium-sparing diuretics, therapy with angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors or angiotensin receptor blockers in cardiorenal disease (chronic kidney disease [CKD] and/or heart failure-HF), digitalis toxicity, massive hemolysis, or muscle trauma. For patients with hyperkalemia, potassium binders (sodium zirconium cyclosilicate, patiromer, and sodium polystyrene) are guideline-recommended for patients with CKD. Importantly, proactive potassium control via routine use of potassium binders in hyperkalemia may incur cost reduction in acute care while simultaneously supporting optimization of medications for comorbid conditions. Hypokalemia can occur in response to diuretic therapy (7-56%), following renal dialysis, or during recovery from endurance exercise and can be equally detrimental as it may raise the risk of ventricular arrhythmias and cardiac arrest. Its diagnosis depends on the level of serum potassium. An ECG is useful in identifying the more severe consequences. Hypokalemia occurs in up to 20% of hospitalized patients and incurs an increased incidence of ventricular and atrial fibrillation. Importantly, "you cannot eat your way out of hypokalemia," i.e., by adding bananas and/or other potassium-providing fruit or juices, hence one needs to provide the patient with K+ supplements in tablet or liquid form or in more serious cases via slow (10 mmol/h) IV supplementation in highly controlled, strict hospital protocols and with continuous ECG monitoring. All these issues of serum potassium disturbances and their CV effects are herein reviewed.

title: Tumour-anchored Purkinje-mediated ventricular tachycardia in a child with cardiac rhabdomyoma.
summary: Cardiac rhabdomyomas are associated with ventricular arrhythmias, but mechanisms remain uncertain. A 10-year-old boy with tuberous sclerosis complex developed verapamil-sensitive fascicular ventricular tachycardia adjacent to a residual cardiac rhabdomyoma. Electrophysiological mapping demonstrated Purkinje-mediated reentry. Catheter ablation at a tumour-adjacent site eliminated the arrhythmia, suggesting that residual rhabdomyoma may anchor a localised reentrant substrate.

title: Echocardiographic markers for left atrial stiffness and left atrial conduction delay in patients with silent paroxysmal atrial fibrillation compared to age-matched controls.
summary:
PURPOSE: To study left atrial stiffness index (LASI) and left atrial activation time (LA-AT) changes in an older population with silent paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF) compared to age-matched control.

METHODS: Individuals with newly diagnosed PAF and a randomly selected age-matched control group without AF were enrolled from STROKESTOP2-study. All participants had NT-proBNP levels 125-900 ng/L. TTE examinations were analyzed retrospectively offline using dedicated software. Besides conventional echocardiographic measurements, LA-AT was obtained by measuring the time delay between the onset of the P-wave on ECG and tissue Doppler Á peak wave in lateral LA wall. LASI was calculated as the ratio of left ventricular filling (E/é) to peak atrial longitudinal strain (PALS).

RESULTS: Mean age was 76 ± 0.3 years. The PAF group (n = 67) presented significant increase of LASI (0.41 (0.29-0.60) vs. 0.32 (0.29-0.43), P = 0.001) and prolonged LA-AT (170 (140-180) ms vs. 140 (120-144) ms, P < 0.001) compared to controls (n = 94). Subgroup analysis in participants with normal LA volume index (LAVI) ≤ 34 ml/m2, LASI and LA-AT remained significantly increased/prolonged in PAF (N = 27) compared to controls (N = 72). NT-proBNP-levels did not differ between PAF (228 (181-348) ng/L) and controls (216 (156-317) ng/L) (P = 0.18). ROC curve analysis identified thresholds LASI > 0.54 and LA-AT > 139 msec for discrimination of silent PAF.

CONCLUSION: Indices reflecting LA stiffness and atrial conduction delay were significantly elevated in recently diagnosed PAF patients. LASI and LA-AT thresholds might non-invasively detect early atrial remodeling without structural enlargement in elderly patients with high risk of PAF and mildly increased NT-proBNP levels.

summary_zh:
目的：研究在无症状阵发性心房颤动（PAF）的老年人群中，与年龄匹配的对照组相比，左心房僵硬度指数（LASI）和左心房激动时间（LA-AT）的变化。

方法：从STROKESTOP2研究中纳入新诊断的PAF个体和随机选择的年龄匹配的无AF对照组。所有参与者的NT-proBNP水平为125-900 ng/L。使用专用软件对TTE检查进行回顾性离线分析。除常规超声心动图测量外，LA-AT通过测量ECG上P波起点与左心房侧壁组织多普勒Á峰波之间的时间延迟获得。LASI计算为左心室充盈（E/é）与峰值心房纵向应变（PALS）的比值。

结果：平均年龄为76 ± 0.3岁。与对照组（n = 94）相比，PAF组（n = 67）的LASI显著增加（0.41（0.29-0.60） vs. 0.32（0.29-0.43），P = 0.001），LA-AT延长（170（140-180） ms vs. 140（120-144） ms，P < 0.001）。在左心房容积指数（LAVI）≤ 34 ml/m2的正常参与者亚组分析中，与对照组（N = 72）相比，PAF组（N = 27）的LASI和LA-AT仍显著增加/延长。PAF组（228（181-348） ng/L）与对照组（216（156-317） ng/L）的NT-proBNP水平无差异（P = 0.18）。ROC曲线分析确定LASI > 0.54和LA-AT > 139 msec为区分无症状PAF的阈值。

结论：在近期诊断的PAF患者中，反映左心房僵硬度和心房传导延迟的指标显著升高。LASI和LA-AT阈值可能非侵入性地检测高PAF风险且NT-proBNP轻度升高的老年患者中无结构性扩大的早期心房重构。

title: Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of SHR-2004, a Novel Humanized Monoclonal Antibody Targeting Factor XI, in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: An Open-Label Phase 1b Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: SHR-2004, a humanized monoclonal antibody targeting factor XI (FXI), demonstrates potential for preventing and treating thrombotic events with reduced bleeding risk. This study evaluated the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) of SHR-2004 in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: In this open-label dose-escalation phase 1b study, patients with AF aged ≥ 40 and < 80 years with a CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥ 1 (male) or ≥ 2 (female) were enrolled to receive six doses of SHR-2004. The primary endpoints were safety and tolerability. PK and PD parameters, including activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) and FXI activity, were also assessed.

RESULTS: From 10 April 2024 to 6 May 2024, ten patients were enrolled to receive SHR-2004 (180 mg subcutaneously, every 2 weeks), with a median age of 68.0 years, and male being in the majority (9/10). The median CHA2DS2-VASc score was 2.5 (range 1-6). The trial was terminated after completion of the 180 mg cohort. SHR-2004 was well tolerated. Treatment-emergent adverse events (AEs) occurred in eight (80.0%) patients, and treatment-related AEs were reported in six (60.0%) patients. All AEs were mild or moderate. Notably, no major or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding events were reported. Plasma exposure of SHR-2004 increased rapidly after administration and reached steady state by day 57 with the geometric mean (CV%) plasma concentration of 24,000 (26.4) ng/mL. This exposure resulted in median FXI activity after the first dose of 1.40% (IQR 1.40-1.40%). The outcomes of PD effects, FXI activity and aPTT prolongation, reached a plateau during the treatment period from day 3 to day 85 indicating that the 180 mg dosage regimen achieved and maintained therapeutic pharmacodynamic steady state.

CONCLUSIONS: Multiple subcutaneous doses of SHR-2004 were generally well tolerated in patients with AF. These preliminary findings support further clinical development of SHR-2004 in this population.

TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: Clinicaltrials.gov identifier: NCT06280768. Trial registration date: 28 February 2024.

AI.tldr: 在10例房颤患者中，每2周皮下注射180mg SHR-2004耐受性良好，无大出血事件，FXI活性中位数降至1.40%，aPTT延长，药效学达稳态。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者需抗凝预防血栓，但现有抗凝药出血风险较高。靶向FXI的单克隆抗体SHR-2004可能在不增加出血的情况下预防血栓，但其在房颤患者中的安全性、药代动力学和药效学尚不明确。
AI.method: 开放标签、剂量递增1b期研究，纳入10例年龄≥40且<80岁、CHA2DS2-VASc评分男性≥1或女性≥2的房颤患者，接受SHR-2004 180mg皮下注射每2周一次，共6次。主要终点为安全性和耐受性，同时评估药代动力学参数及药效学指标（aPTT和FXI活性）。
AI.result: 中位年龄68.0岁，男性9例，中位CHA2DS2-VASc评分2.5（范围1-6）。治疗中出现不良事件8例（80.0%），治疗相关不良事件6例（60.0%），均为轻中度；未报告大出血或临床相关非大出血事件。SHR-2004血浆暴露迅速上升，第57天达稳态，几何均值（CV%）浓度为24,000（26.4）ng/mL；首次给药后FXI活性中位数为1.40%（IQR 1.40-1.40%）。药效学指标FXI活性和aPTT延长在第3天至第85天达平台期，表明180mg方案达到并维持治疗性药效学稳态。

summary_zh:
背景：SHR-2004是一种靶向因子XI（FXI）的人源化单克隆抗体，具有预防和治疗血栓事件并降低出血风险的潜力。本研究评估了SHR-2004在心房颤动（AF）患者中的安全性、耐受性、药代动力学（PK）和药效动力学（PD）。

方法：在这项开放标签剂量递增1b期研究中，年龄≥40岁且<80岁、CHA2DS2-VASc评分≥1（男性）或≥2（女性）的AF患者被纳入接受六剂SHR-2004治疗。主要终点为安全性和耐受性。还评估了PK和PD参数，包括活化部分凝血活酶时间（aPTT）和FXI活性。

结果：从2024年4月10日至2024年5月6日，共纳入10例患者接受SHR-2004治疗（180 mg皮下注射，每2周一次），中位年龄为68.0岁，男性占多数（9/10）。中位CHA2DS2-VASc评分为2.5（范围1-6）。在完成180 mg队列后试验终止。SHR-2004耐受性良好。8例（80.0%）患者发生治疗中出现的不良事件（AE），6例（60.0%）患者报告了治疗相关AE。所有AE均为轻度或中度。值得注意的是，未报告大出血或临床相关非大出血事件。给药后SHR-2004的血浆暴露迅速增加，至第57天达到稳态，几何均值（CV%）血浆浓度为24,000（26.4）ng/mL。该暴露导致首次给药后中位FXI活性为1.40%（IQR 1.40-1.40%）。PD效应（FXI活性和aPTT延长）的结果在治疗期间第3天至第85天达到平台期，表明180 mg给药方案达到并维持了治疗性药效动力学稳态。

结论：多次皮下注射SHR-2004在AF患者中通常耐受性良好。这些初步发现支持SHR-2004在该人群中的进一步临床开发。

title: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease/Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and the Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Cohort Studies.
summary: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), formerly non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), has been inconsistently linked to incident atrial fibrillation (AF) across observational cohorts. We performed an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort studies, following the Meta-analysis Of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (MOOSE) guidelines, searching PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science through July 25, 2026, for studies comparing incident AF risk in adults with versus without NAFLD/MASLD. Adjusted effect estimates were pooled using a random-effects model, with heterogeneity assessed via the I² statistic and explored through subgroup and univariable meta-regression analyses. Eighteen cohort studies comprising over 15 million participants from Asia, Europe, and North America met inclusion criteria. Pooling all studies demonstrated a significantly increased risk of incident AF among individuals with NAFLD/MASLD compared with those without (pooled risk ratio (RR) 1.23, 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.12-1.34, p < 0.001), with substantial statistical heterogeneity (I² = 99.4%). In an exploratory analysis of three studies, advanced disease with hepatic fibrosis was also associated with increased AF risk (RR 1.19, 95% CI 1.11-1.28). In the present meta-analysis, NAFLD/MASLD was associated with a modestly higher risk of incident AF after adjustment for conventional cardiometabolic risk factors, although heterogeneity was very high. These findings support attention to AF risk in this population and the use of standardized diagnostic approaches in future research.

AI.tldr: 纳入18项队列、逾1500万人的荟萃分析显示，NAFLD/MASLD患者发生房颤的风险较无该病者升高约23%（RR 1.23，95%CI 1.12-1.34）。
AI.motivation: NAFLD/MASLD与房颤发病风险的关联在既往观察性队列中结果不一致，临床对该人群是否需要加强房颤筛查缺乏统一证据，故开展更新的系统评价与荟萃分析。
AI.method: 按MOOSE指南开展的系统评价与荟萃分析，检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus和Web of Science至2026年7月25日，纳入比较成人NAFLD/MASLD与无该病人群新发房颤风险的队列研究；采用随机效应模型合并校正后效应量，以I²评估异质性并行亚组及单因素meta回归分析。
AI.result: 共纳入18项队列研究、逾1500万来自亚洲、欧洲和北美的受试者。合并分析显示NAFLD/MASLD与新发房颤风险显著升高相关（合并RR 1.23，95%CI 1.12-1.34，P<0.001），异质性很高（I²=99.4%）。探索性分析中3项研究提示合并肝纤维化的进展期肝病亦与房颤风险升高相关（RR 1.19，95%CI 1.11-1.28）。
AI.conclusion: 在校正传统心血管代谢危险因素后，NAFLD/MASLD仍与房颤发病风险轻度升高相关，提示应对该人群关注房颤风险；但研究间异质性极高，且为观察性证据，不能推断因果关系，未来研究需采用标准化诊断方法并进一步明确肝纤维化分层的作用。

title: Atrial Fibrillation in Tribal and Non-tribal Populations: A Comparative Analysis From Eastern India.
summary: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) is an increasingly prevalent arrhythmia in India, where rheumatic heart disease and cardiometabolic etiologies coexist. This study compared the demographic profile, clinical presentation, associated clinical conditions, echocardiographic characteristics, thromboembolic risk, and anticoagulation practices between tribal patients and non-tribal patients in Eastern India. Methods This retrospective hospital-based cross-sectional study included 364 consecutive adult patients with AF (106 tribal and 258 non-tribal patients) admitted between January 2022 and December 2024. Clinical, electrocardiographic, echocardiographic, and treatment data were extracted from hospital records. Continuous variables were compared using Welch's t-test and categorical variables using Pearson's chi-square test. Results Tribal patients more frequently presented with first-diagnosed AF (81/106, 76.4% vs. 153/258, 59.3%; p = 0.002), higher ventricular rates (112.6 ± 25.1 vs. 102.3 ± 19.6 beats/min; p < 0.001), lower left ventricular ejection fraction (46.0 ± 11.7% vs. 51.0 ± 10.5%; p < 0.001), and more heart failure symptoms at presentation (27/106, 25.4% vs. 41/258, 15.9%; p = 0.033). Lifestyle-related risk factors were significantly more prevalent among tribal patients (79/106, 74.5% vs. 137/258, 53.1%; p < 0.001). Conversely, non-tribal patients had a higher prevalence of cardiometabolic disorders (168/258, 65.1% vs. 43/106, 40.6%; p < 0.001), ischemic cardiovascular disease (69/258, 26.7% vs. 18/106, 17.0%; p = 0.047), chronic kidney disease (93/258, 36.0% vs. 25/106, 23.6%; p = 0.021), higher CHA₂DS₂-VASc scores (2.38 ± 1.66 vs. 1.86 ± 1.45; p = 0.004), and a greater proportion meeting criteria for long-term oral anticoagulation (192/258, 74.4% vs. 67/106, 63.2%; p = 0.032). Rheumatic heart disease, heart failure, left atrial thrombus, ischemic stroke, and anticoagulant prescribing patterns were comparable between the two groups. Conclusions Tribal patients with AF had more first-diagnosed AF, higher ventricular rates, lower left ventricular systolic function, and greater lifestyle-related risk factors, whereas non-tribal patients had greater cardiometabolic and thromboembolic risk. These findings demonstrate differences in the clinical presentation and risk profile of AF within this hospital-based cohort and highlight the need for population-specific strategies to improve AF detection, prevention, and management in Eastern India.

AI.tldr: 印度东部部落房颤患者首诊房颤比例更高、心室率更快、左室射血分数更低且生活方式危险因素更多，而非部落患者心代谢紊乱和血栓栓塞风险更高。

AI.method: 回顾性医院横断面研究，纳入2022年1月至2024年12月印度东部连续住院的364例成人房颤患者（部落106例，非部落258例），从病历提取临床、心电图、超声心动图和治療数据，连续变量用Welch t检验、分类变量用Pearson卡方检验比较。
AI.result: 部落组首诊房颤比例更高（76.4% vs 59.3%，p=0.002），心室率更快（112.6±25.1 vs 102.3±19.6次/分，p<0.001），左室射血分数更低（46.0±11.7% vs 51.0±10.5%，p<0.001），心衰症状更多（25.4% vs 15.9%，p=0.033），生活方式危险因素更普遍（74.5% vs 53.1%，p<0.001）。非部落组心代谢紊乱（65.1% vs 40.6%，p<0.001）、缺血性心血管病（26.7% vs 17.0%，p=0.047）、慢性肾病（36.0% vs 23.6%，p=0.021）比例更高，CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分更高（2.38±1.66 vs 1.86±1.45，p=0.004），符合长期口服抗凝指征者更多（74.4% vs 63.2%，p=0.032）。风湿性心脏病、心衰、左房血栓、缺血性卒中和抗凝处方模式两组无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 印度东部部落与非部落房颤患者在临床表现和风险谱上存在差异，部落患者以生活方式危险因素和收缩功能减低为主，非部落患者心代谢和血栓栓塞风险更高，提示需制定人群特异性策略以改善房颤检测、预防和管理；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AF）在印度是一种日益普遍的心律失常，风湿性心脏病和心脏代谢病因并存。本研究比较了印度东部部落患者与非部落患者的人口学特征、临床表现、相关临床状况、超声心动图特征、血栓栓塞风险及抗凝实践。方法：这项回顾性医院横断面研究纳入了2022年1月至2024年12月期间连续入院的364例成年AF患者（106例部落患者和258例非部落患者）。从医院记录中提取临床、心电图、超声心动图及治疗数据。连续变量采用Welch t检验比较，分类变量采用Pearson卡方检验比较。结果：部落患者更常表现为首次诊断的AF（81/106，76.4% vs. 153/258，59.3%；p = 0.002）、更高的心室率（112.6 ± 25.1 vs. 102.3 ± 19.6 次/分；p < 0.001）、更低的左心室射血分数（46.0 ± 11.7% vs. 51.0 ± 10.5%；p < 0.001）以及就诊时更多的心力衰竭症状（27/106，25.4% vs. 41/258，15.9%；p = 0.033）。生活方式相关危险因素在部落患者中显著更普遍（79/106，74.5% vs. 137/258，53.1%；p < 0.001）。相反，非部落患者的心脏代谢疾病患病率更高（168/258，65.1% vs. 43/106，40.6%；p < 0.001）、缺血性心血管疾病（69/258，26.7% vs. 18/106，17.0%；p = 0.047）、慢性肾脏病（93/258，36.0% vs. 25/106，23.6%；p = 0.021）、更高的CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分（2.38 ± 1.66 vs. 1.86 ± 1.45；p = 0.004），以及更大比例符合长期口服抗凝标准（192/258，74.4% vs. 67/106，63.2%；p = 0.032）。风湿性心脏病、心力衰竭、左心房血栓、缺血性卒中及抗凝药处方模式在两组间相当。结论：部落AF患者更多为首次诊断的AF、心室率更高、左心室收缩功能更低、生活方式相关危险因素更多，而非部落患者的心脏代谢和血栓栓塞风险更高。这些发现表明该医院队列中AF的临床表现和风险特征存在差异，并强调需要针对人群特异性的策略来改善印度东部AF的检测、预防和管理。

title: Obesity and Atrial Fibrillation: Integrating Lifestyle, Pharmacotherapy and Ablation.
Suspected atrioesophageal fistula complicated by coronary air embolism after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: direct angiographic visualization and catheter aspiration in a case report.
summary:
Atrioesophageal fistula is a rare but fatal complication of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation(AF). It may present with infection, dysphagia or other swallowing-related symptoms, neurologic events, and systemic air embolism; coronary air embolism is even less common.

CASE SUMMARY: An 84-year-old woman was admitted with recurrent palpitations lasting 1 h, approximately 1 month after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation and left atrial appendage closure(RFCA & LAAC). On admission, she was in sinus rhythm and had a normal cardiac troponin level. Four hours after admission, she abruptly became unresponsive and developed fever and severe respiratory abnormalities. Electrocardiography subsequently showed ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF. Emergency coronary angiography demonstrated gas in the mid right coronary artery with TIMI 0 distal flow, and catheter aspiration was performed. Computed tomography (CT) of the head and chest revealed gas at multiple sites, including the intracranial compartment, cardiac chambers, and great vessels. Blood cultures grew Streptococcus constellatus and other streptococci. Given the recent left atrial ablation, acute neurologic and myocardial ischemic manifestations, multisite intravascular gas, and bacteremia with organisms associated with the oropharyngeal or gastrointestinal flora, an atrioesophageal fistula complicated by systemic air embolism was strongly suspected. Her condition deteriorated rapidly, and she developed cardiac arrest and died approximately 27 h after admission.

CONCLUSION: Atrioesophageal fistula and coronary air embolism should be considered in patients who develop fever, impaired consciousness, or acute ST-segment elevation within several weeks of atrial fibrillation ablation. Coronary angiography can directly visualize intracoronary gas and allow catheter aspiration; however, the certainty of an atrioesophageal fistula diagnosis should remain commensurate with the available imaging evidence.

AI.tldr: 84岁女性房颤射频消融联合左心耳封堵术后1个月，突发意识丧失、发热和ST段抬高，冠脉造影直接显示右冠状动脉气体并抽吸，疑似房食管瘘并发冠脉空气栓塞，27小时内死亡。
AI.motivation: 房食管瘘是房颤导管消融的罕见但致命并发症，可表现为感染、吞咽困难、神经系统事件和系统性空气栓塞；冠脉空气栓塞更为罕见。早期识别和诊断困难，既往证据多为个案报道，缺乏直接影像学证据和有效处理策略。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例84岁女性，因房颤行射频导管消融联合左心耳封堵术后约1个月，因反复心悸1小时入院。入院时窦性心律，肌钙蛋白正常。4小时后突发无反应、发热和严重呼吸异常，心电图显示II、III、aVF导联ST段抬高。急诊冠状动脉造影显示右冠状动脉中段气体，远端TIMI 0级血流，行导管抽吸。头部和胸部CT显示颅内、心腔和大血管等多部位气体。血培养生长星座链球菌和其他链球菌。结合近期左房消融史、急性神经和心肌缺血表现、多部位血管内气体及口咽/胃肠道菌群菌血症，高度怀疑房食管瘘并发系统性空气栓塞。
AI.result: 冠状动脉造影直接可视右冠状动脉中段气体，远端TIMI 0级血流，行导管抽吸。CT显示颅内、心腔和大血管多部位气体。血培养阳性。患者病情迅速恶化，发生心脏骤停，入院约27小时后死亡。摘要未报告其他统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 房颤消融术后数周内出现发热、意识障碍或急性ST段抬高时，应警惕房食管瘘和冠脉空气栓塞。冠状动脉造影可直接显示冠脉内气体并允许导管抽吸；但房食管瘘诊断的确定性应与现有影像学证据相符。临床意义在于提高对致命并发症的早期识别，局限性为单例病例报告，证据级别低。

summary_zh:
背景：心房食管瘘是心房颤动（AF）导管消融术的一种罕见但致命的并发症。它可能表现为感染、吞咽困难或其他吞咽相关症状、神经系统事件和全身性空气栓塞；冠状动脉空气栓塞更为罕见。

病例摘要：一名84岁女性因反复心悸持续1小时入院，约在心房颤动射频导管消融和左心耳封堵术（RFCA & LAAC）后1个月。入院时，她处于窦性心律，心肌肌钙蛋白水平正常。入院4小时后，她突然变得无反应，并出现发热和严重的呼吸异常。随后心电图显示II、III和aVF导联ST段抬高。急诊冠状动脉造影显示右冠状动脉中段有气体，远端血流TIMI 0级，并进行了导管抽吸。头部和胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）显示多个部位有气体，包括颅内、心腔和大血管。血培养生长出星座链球菌和其他链球菌。鉴于近期左心房消融、急性神经和心肌缺血表现、多部位血管内气体以及与口咽或胃肠道菌群相关的菌血症，强烈怀疑心房食管瘘并发全身性空气栓塞。她的病情迅速恶化，出现心脏骤停，并在入院约27小时后死亡。

结论：对于心房颤动消融后数周内出现发热、意识障碍或急性ST段抬高的患者，应考虑心房食管瘘和冠状动脉空气栓塞。冠状动脉造影可以直接显示冠状动脉内气体并进行导管抽吸；然而，心房食管瘘诊断的确定性应与可用的影像学证据相符。

title: Plasma magnesium levels and postoperative atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery: a cohort study.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is common after cardiac surgery, and hypomagnesemia has been proposed as a modifiable risk factor. In centers with active magnesium repletion protocols, however, overt hypomagnesemia has become uncommon. We aimed to determine whether postoperative plasma magnesium concentration is independently associated with POAF.

METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 435 adults undergoing cardiac surgery at a hospital specializing in cardiovascular disease. Postoperative plasma magnesium concentration, assessed at intensive care unit admission, as the mean value, and as the lowest value, was evaluated as the primary exposure in multivariable logistic regression models adjusted for relevant preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative covariates.

RESULTS: Isolated coronary artery bypass grafting was the most frequent procedure (46.6%). Overall mortality was 3.2%, and POAF incidence was 16.8%. Under active repletion, hypomagnesemia occurred in only 3.4% of patients. None of the three magnesium measures was independently associated with POAF. In contrast, age, type of surgical procedure, severe left ventricular dysfunction, and postoperative acute kidney injury were independently associated with POAF.

CONCLUSIONS: Under a protocol of active postoperative magnesium repletion, we did not detect an independent association between plasma magnesium concentration-within the observed normal-to-high range-and POAF. This complication was primarily related to age, type of surgery, and severe ventricular dysfunction, factors that should guide postoperative risk stratification; acute kidney injury showed a concurrent association with POAF and may act as a marker of shared postoperative risk factors rather than a causal factor.

title: Remimazolam for Procedural Sedation During Synchronized Electrical Cardioversion in the Emergency Department.
summary: Synchronized electrical cardioversion necessitates procedural sedation to ensure patient comfort and amnesia. Remimazolam is a novel, ultrashort-acting intravenous benzodiazepine with organ-independent esterase metabolism, a favorable safety profile, and flumazenil reversibility. Although, previously described in the electrophysiology laboratory, use of remimazolam has not been reported for electrical cardioversion in the emergency department. In this case, a 67-year-old man with sudden-onset paroxysmal atrial fibrillation presented in symptomatic atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response. Following rate and rhythm optimization, the decision was made to proceed with synchronized electrical cardioversion under procedural sedation. After consent was obtained, remimazolam (5 mg intravenously) was administered as a single bolus. Sedation onset occurred at 49 seconds, with adequate depth achieved at 1 minute 37 seconds. A single synchronized biphasic 200 joule electric shock was successfully delivered at 2 minutes 20 seconds, converting the patient to normal sinus rhythm. Eye opening occurred at 3 minutes 50 seconds, with return to baseline orientation at 4 minutes 30 seconds. No apnea, hypoxia, hemodynamic instability, or procedural recall was observed. Continuous end-tidal carbon dioxide monitoring confirmed uninterrupted spontaneous ventilation throughout. The rapid onset, hemodynamic stability, and remarkably brief recovery time observed support its potential as a first-line sedative for emergency department cardioversion. Further prospective study in this setting is warranted.

title: Outcomes of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement in the Middle East and North Africa: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Data on transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) outcomes in the Middle East and North Africa region are limited. We synthesized available evidence on post-TAVR clinical outcomes in the Middle East and North Africa region.

METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and Scopus from inception through May 2025 for studies reporting TAVR outcomes in this region. Outcomes included device success, all-cause death, cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, new-onset atrial fibrillation, moderate to severe paravalvular leak, and permanent pacemaker implantation. Overall incidence rates were pooled via Poisson analysis and reported per 100 person-years with 95% CIs.

RESULTS: Forty-eight studies encompassing 7331 patients (mean age, 76.9±8.5 years; 52.4% women) were included. Pooled device success rate was 96.4% (95% CI, 95.8%-97.0%). At latest follow-up, pooled incidence rates per 100 person-years were 13.7 for all-cause death (95% CI, 12.9-14.6), 4.8 for cardiovascular death (95% CI, 4.1-5.7), 1.0 for myocardial infarction (95% CI, 0.7-1.4), 1.6 for stroke (95% CI, 1.3-1.9), 2.7 for moderate to severe paravalvular leak (95% CI, 2.2-3.4), 6.5 for new-onset atrial fibrillation (95% CI, 5.5-7.7), and 10.0 for permanent pacemaker implantation (95% CI, 9.2-10.9). Post hoc exploratory meta-regression identified significant study-level modifying effects, with higher mean age and greater use of first-generation versus second-generation valves associated with higher overall all-cause mortality incidence following TAVR. Certainty of evidence was low or very low across all outcomes.

CONCLUSIONS: TAVR in the Middle East and North Africa region was associated with high device success rate and relatively low cardiovascular death. Permanent pacemaker implantation was the most prevalent post-TAVR complication. Further studies are warranted to optimize TAVR practice in this region.

title: Efficacy of Stellate Ganglion Block for Preventing Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Stellate ganglion block (SGB) may reduce postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) by modulating the autonomic nervous system. This study evaluated the efficacy of preoperative SGB in preventing POAF following cardiac surgery.

METHODS: In this single-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 140 patients undergoing valve surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass were assigned (1:1) to ultrasound-guided right SGB with 7 mL of 0.5% ropivacaine or 7 mL of normal saline. The primary outcome was the incidence of POAF from postoperative day 0 to day 7 or until discharge.

RESULTS: A total of 132 patients completed the study and were included in the modified intention-to-treat population (SGB group: n=65; saline group: n=67). POAF occurred in 43% of the SGB group and 40% of the saline group (odds ratio [OR], 0.99 [95% CI, 0.46-2.15], adjusted P=0.989). The SGB group demonstrated a lower incidence of intraoperative ventricular fibrillation/ventricular tachycardia requiring defibrillation after aortic cross-clamp release (6% versus 19%; OR, 0.21 [95% CI, 0.06-0.80]; adjusted P=0.022), lower postoperative high-sensitivity troponin I levels (median difference: -2562 ng/L [95% CI, -4301 to -45]; P=0.045), and a reduced risk of postoperative acute kidney injury (5% versus 18%; OR, 0.24 [95% CI, 0.06-0.98]; adjusted P=0.046).

CONCLUSIONS: While preoperative SGB did not reduce the incidence of POAF, it was associated with potential benefits, including a lower requirement for intraoperative defibrillation attributable to ventricular arrhythmias, attenuated myocardial injury (as indicated by lower high-sensitivity troponin I levels), and a decreased risk of postoperative acute kidney injury.

方法：在这项单中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验中，140例接受体外循环瓣膜手术的患者按1:1比例分配至超声引导下右侧SGB组（注射7 mL 0.5%罗哌卡因）或生理盐水组（注射7 mL生理盐水）。主要结局为术后第0天至第7天或出院前POAF的发生率。

结果：共132例患者完成研究并纳入改良意向治疗人群（SGB组：n=65；生理盐水组：n=67）。SGB组POAF发生率为43%，生理盐水组为40%（比值比[OR]，0.99 [95% CI，0.46-2.15]，校正P=0.989）。SGB组在主动脉阻断开放后需除颤的术中室颤/室速发生率较低（6% vs 19%；OR，0.21 [95% CI，0.06-0.80]；校正P=0.022），术后高敏肌钙蛋白I水平较低（中位差值：-2562 ng/L [95% CI，-4301至-45]；P=0.045），且术后急性肾损伤风险降低（5% vs 18%；OR，0.24 [95% CI，0.06-0.98]；校正P=0.046）。

结论：虽然术前SGB未降低POAF发生率，但与潜在获益相关，包括因室性心律失常需术中除颤的需求较低、心肌损伤减轻（表现为高敏肌钙蛋白I水平较低）以及术后急性肾损伤风险降低。

title: Fluoroscopy-Free Esophageal Temperature Probe Positioning During Hybrid Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
Effectiveness of Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Therapy for Primary Prevention in Patients with Nonischemic Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Primary prevention with an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) has become an increasingly debated strategy, with its role in patients with nonischemic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) undergoing continued reassessment.

OBJECTIVE: To summarize the available scientific evidence on the effectiveness of ICD therapy for primary prevention in patients with nonischemic HFrEF.

METHODS: A rapid systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the recommendations of the Cochrane Rapid Reviews Methods Group and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses statement. Statistical significance was defined as a two-sided p-value < 0.05. Searches were performed in the MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL databases. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating ICD implantation for primary prevention were included, with sudden cardiac death (SCD), cardiovascular mortality, and all-cause mortality as the primary outcomes.

RESULTS: A total of 18 publications reporting daata from six pivotal RCTs were included. ICD therapy was associated with a statistically significant reduction in SCD (relative risk [RR] 0.41; 95%CI 0.26-0.65; high-certainty evidence) and cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.75; 95%CI 0.59-0.95; high-certainty evidence). For all-cause mortality, the primary analysis showed no statistically significant difference between groups (RR 0.88; 95%CI 0.72-1.07; moderate-certainty evidence). In the subgroup analysis, studies with shorter follow-up (< 6.8 years) demonstrated a significant reduction in all-cause mortality (RR 0.69; 95%CI 0.52-0.92).

CONCLUSION: In patients with nonischemic HFrEF, ICD therapy reduced SCD and cardiovascular mortality but did not significantly reduce all-cause mortality in the primary analysis. These findings support the use of ICD therapy when guided by individualized clinical assessment.

AI.motivation: ICD用于一级预防的策略争议日益增多，其在非缺血性射血分数降低的心衰（HFrEF）患者中的作用仍在被重新评估，需要汇总现有证据明确疗效。
AI.method: 快速系统评价与荟萃分析，遵循Cochrane快速综述方法学组建议及PRISMA声明；检索MEDLINE、Embase和CENTRAL数据库，纳入评估ICD一级预防的随机对照试验（RCT）；主要终点为心源性猝死（SCD）、心血管死亡和全因死亡；统计学显著性定义为双侧P<0.05。
AI.result: 共纳入6项关键RCT的18篇文献。ICD治疗显著降低SCD（RR 0.41；95%CI 0.26-0.65；高确定性证据）和心血管死亡（RR 0.75；95%CI 0.59-0.95；高确定性证据）；全因死亡主要分析无显著差异（RR 0.88；95%CI 0.72-1.07；中等确定性证据）；亚组分析中随访<6.8年的研究显示全因死亡显著降低（RR 0.69；95%CI 0.52-0.92）。
AI.conclusion: 在非缺血性HFrEF患者中，ICD治疗可降低SCD和心血管死亡，但主要分析未显著降低全因死亡；结果支持在个体化临床评估指导下使用ICD，随访时长可能影响全因死亡获益，需结合患者具体情况决策。

title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and the risk of ventricular arrhythmia in patients with acute myocardial infarction and type 2 diabetes mellitus: a propensity score-matched cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Ventricular arrhythmia (VA) substantially contributes to sudden cardiac death in patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have demonstrated cardiovascular benefits; however, their influence on post-AMI ventricular arrhythmogenesis remains unclear.

METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 1,873 patients with concurrent AMI and T2DM admitted between January 2018 and December 2022. Using propensity score matching (1:2, nearest-neighbor), 277 GLP-1RA users were matched with 554 controls. The primary endpoint was incident VA. Cox proportional hazards regression, inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW), Firth's penalized likelihood regression, and Fine-Gray competing risk analysis were performed.

RESULTS: Over a median follow-up of 2.5 years, GLP-1RA use was associated with a reduced risk of VA (adjusted HR 0.61, 95% CI 0.37-0.98, P = 0.040), MACE (HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.45-0.96, P = 0.030), cardiovascular death (HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.86, P = 0.010), and heart failure rehospitalization (HR 0.42, 95% CI 0.26-0.68, P < 0.001). All-cause mortality showed a non-significant trend (HR 0.84, 95% CI 0.59-1.18, P = 0.310). Firth's penalized regression confirmed the primary finding (HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.36-0.95, P = 0.029). The Fine-Gray model yielded a subdistribution HR of 0.63 (95% CI 0.39-1.02, P = 0.058) after accounting for competing mortality risk. The 90-day landmark analysis (HR 0.65, 95% CI 0.39-1.06, P = 0.085) and the time-varying exposure Cox model (HR 0.66, 95% CI 0.40-1.08, P = 0.097) were directionally concordant but did not reach statistical significance.

CONCLUSIONS: GLP-1RA therapy was associated with a lower risk of VA and improved cardiovascular outcomes in patients with AMI and T2DM. Because several sensitivity analyses, including the Fine-Gray competing-risk, landmark, and time-varying models, were borderline non-significant, these findings should be interpreted with caution and regarded as hypothesis-generating, warranting confirmation in prospective randomized trials.

AI.tldr: 在合并2型糖尿病的急性心肌梗死患者中，GLP-1受体激动剂治疗与室性心律失常风险降低相关（校正HR 0.61），但多项敏感性分析未达统计学显著性，结论需谨慎解读。
AI.motivation: 室性心律失常是急性心肌梗死（AMI）合并2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者心源性猝死的重要原因。GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）已显示心血管获益，但其对AMI后室性心律失常发生的影响尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入2018年1月至2022年12月收治的1,873例AMI合并T2DM患者。采用倾向性评分匹配（1:2，最近邻法），将277例GLP-1RA使用者与554例对照匹配。主要终点为室性心律失常（VA）发生。统计方法包括Cox比例风险回归、逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）、Firth惩罚似然回归和Fine-Gray竞争风险分析。
AI.result: 中位随访2.5年，GLP-1RA使用与VA风险降低相关（校正HR 0.61，95%CI 0.37-0.98，P=0.040），MACE（HR 0.66，95%CI 0.45-0.96，P=0.030）、心血管死亡（HR 0.52，95%CI 0.32-0.86，P=0.010）和心力衰竭再住院（HR 0.42，95%CI 0.26-0.68，P<0.001）风险亦降低。全因死亡率呈非显著趋势（HR 0.84，95%CI 0.59-1.18，P=0.310）。Firth惩罚回归证实主要发现（HR 0.58，95%CI 0.36-0.95，P=0.029）。Fine-Gray模型竞争风险分析显示亚分布HR 0.63（95%CI 0.39-1.02，P=0.058）。90天landmark分析（HR 0.65，95%CI 0.39-1.06，P=0.085）和时变暴露Cox模型（HR 0.66，95%CI 0.40-1.08，P=0.097）方向一致但未达统计学显著性。
AI.conclusion: GLP-1RA治疗与AMI合并T2DM患者VA风险降低及心血管结局改善相关。然而，包括Fine-Gray竞争风险、landmark和时变模型在内的多项敏感性分析结果处于临界非显著，应谨慎解读，视为假设生成性发现，需前瞻性随机试验证实。对电生理实践的影响：GLP-1RA可能作为减少室性心律失常的潜在策略，但目前证据尚不足以改变临床实践。局限性包括回顾性设计、残余混杂可能以及部分分析未达显著性。

title: Complex arrhythmias in the absence of severe valvulitis: a paediatric case of acute rheumatic fever.
summary: A 15-year-old boy was admitted to the emergency department with arthralgia of the knee. He was diagnosed with acute rheumatic fever based on clinical examination, electrocardiography, echocardiography, and elevated inflammatory markers including C-reactive protein, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and anti-streptolysin O titre. First-degree and second-degree Mobitz type 1 atrioventricular blocks, moderate frequency uniform ventricular premature beats, as well as non-sustained ventricular tachycardia, were detected on 24-hour Holter electrocardiography monitoring.

title: Sudden Cardiac Death in Firefighters From the United States: A 16-Year Postmortem Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) is the leading cause of duty-related death among firefighters. Understanding postmortem cardiovascular abnormalities associated with SCD is critical to guiding fire service cardiovascular disease screening and prevention programs.

METHODS: This study included US firefighters who had a duty-related death over a 16-year period (1999-2014) with available postmortem reports (autopsy/medical examiner reports). Cases were systematically reviewed to identify cases of SCD. For each SCD case, the primary etiology of SCD was adjudicated by experts in sports cardiology and cardiovascular pathology.

RESULTS: Postmortem evaluations were available for 794 of 2100 (37.8%) on-duty firefighter deaths over the study period (average age, 44±13 years; age range, 17-82 years; 4.0% women). A total of 312 of 794 (39.3%) firefighter deaths were adjudicated as SCD. A total of 255 of 312 (81.8%) SCD events were attributable to coronary artery disease/ischemic heart disease or hypertensive heart disease, which both are associated with traditional cardiovascular risk factors. The leading etiology of SCD among young firefighters (aged <40 years) was also coronary artery disease/ischemic heart disease (24/50 [48.0%]). Of firefighters who had an exertional SCD event thought to be secondary to coronary artery disease (n=97), a total of 62 of 91 (68.1%) had severe fixed coronary stenosis, while 29 of 91 (31.9%) demonstrated acute plaque rupture/thrombosis.

CONCLUSIONS: More than 80% of on-duty SCD events among US firefighters are due to coronary artery disease and hypertensive heart disease that may be prevented by early disease identification and risk factor modification. Future studies should assess the efficacy of more rigorous firefighter cardiovascular disease screening and management practices.

AI.tldr: 美国消防员执勤期间心脏性猝死中，81.8%由冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病或高血压性心脏病所致，提示早期筛查和危险因素干预可能预防多数事件。
AI.motivation: 心脏性猝死是消防员执勤相关死亡的首位原因，但既往缺乏基于尸检报告的系统性病因分析，明确猝死的死后心血管异常对指导消防部门心血管筛查和预防项目至关重要。
AI.method: 回顾性尸检分析，纳入1999-2014年16年间美国执勤相关死亡且有尸检/法医报告的消防员794例（占同期2100例死亡的37.8%；平均年龄44±13岁，范围17-82岁；女性4.0%）。系统审阅判定心脏性猝死病例，由运动心脏病学和心血管病理学专家裁定主要病因。
AI.result: 794例中312例（39.3%）判定为心脏性猝死。255/312（81.8%）归因于冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病或高血压性心脏病。年轻消防员（<40岁）中首位病因同为冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病（24/50，48.0%）。在考虑为冠状动脉疾病所致的劳力性心脏性猝死中（n=97），91例有评估者中62例（68.1%）存在严重固定性冠状动脉狭窄，29例（31.9%）显示急性斑块破裂/血栓形成。
AI.conclusion: 美国消防员执勤心脏性猝死中超过80%由冠状动脉疾病和高血压性心脏病所致，这些疾病可能通过早期识别和危险因素干预预防。未来需评估更严格的消防员心血管筛查和管理措施的疗效。本研究为回顾性尸检分析，仅37.8%的死亡有尸检报告，可能存在选择偏倚。

方法：本研究纳入在16年期间（1999-2014年）因公死亡且有可用尸检报告（尸检/法医报告）的美国消防员。对病例进行系统审查以识别SCD病例。对于每个SCD病例，由运动心脏病学和心血管病理学专家裁定SCD的主要病因。

结果：在研究期间，2100例执勤消防员死亡中有794例（37.8%）可获得尸检评估（平均年龄44±13岁；年龄范围17-82岁；女性占4.0%）。794例消防员死亡中，共有312例（39.3%）被裁定为SCD。312例SCD事件中，共有255例（81.8%）可归因于冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病或高血压性心脏病，两者均与传统的 cardiovascular 危险因素相关。年轻消防员（年龄<40岁）中SCD的主要病因也是冠状动脉疾病/缺血性心脏病（24/50 [48.0%]）。在因冠状动脉疾病导致劳力性SCD事件的消防员中（n=97），91例中有62例（68.1%）存在严重的固定性冠状动脉狭窄，而91例中有29例（31.9%）显示急性斑块破裂/血栓形成。

结论：美国消防员中超过80%的执勤SCD事件由冠状动脉疾病和高血压性心脏病引起，这些疾病可能通过早期疾病识别和危险因素干预来预防。未来研究应评估更严格的消防员心血管疾病筛查和管理实践的有效性。

title: Low-Intensity Focused Ultrasound Modulation of Stellate Ganglion Attenuates Post-STEMI Ventricular Arrhythmias: First-in-Human Feasibility Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sympathetic overactivation contributes to ventricular arrhythmias (VAs) after ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Preclinical study demonstrated that low-intensity focused ultrasound (LIFU) modulation of the left stellate ganglion (LSG) reduced post-STEMI VAs.

OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to investigate whether LIFU modulation of LSG reduces VAs following primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with STEMI.

METHODS: In this single-center, prospective, randomized, sham-controlled exploratory study, 41 STEMI undergoing primary PCI were assigned to LIFU modulation (n = 20) or sham stimulation (n = 21). LIFU was initiated in the catheterization laboratory and continued in the ward. All patients were followed up for 7 days and underwent Holter monitoring, serum biomarker assessment, echocardiographic evaluation, and safety assessment.

RESULTS: LIFU significantly reduced VA burden within 72 hours after PCI. Heart rate variability analysis indicated reduced low-frequency power and a decreased low-frequency/high-frequency ratio. Exploratory analyses also showed lower levels of proinflammatory cytokines and sympathetic neurotransmitters. Myocardial injury markers did not differ significantly between groups, whereas left ventricular ejection fraction was higher in the LIFU group on day 7. Furthermore, no significant organ dysfunction or thermal injury was observed following LIFU intervention.

CONCLUSIONS: LIFU modulation of LSG might attenuate sympathetic activity and reduce VAs in patients with STEMI undergoing PCI. This study provides the first clinical evidence supporting LIFU as a promising noninvasive neuromodulatory strategy for VA prevention in the STEMI setting. Larger multicenter trials (NCT07587294/ChiCTR2600122798, ongoing) are warranted to confirm these findings. This study offers a novel strategy for the management of VAs following STEMI.

AI.tldr: 首个人体可行性研究显示，低强度聚焦超声调控左侧星状神经节可降低STEMI直接PCI后72小时室性心律失常负荷，并改善心率变异性，安全性良好。
AI.motivation: STEMI后交感神经过度激活是室性心律失常的重要机制，临床缺乏无创、可早期实施的神经调控手段；既往仅临床前研究提示低强度聚焦超声调控左侧星状神经节可减少梗死后室性心律失常，尚缺乏人体证据。
AI.method: 单中心、前瞻性、随机、假刺激对照探索性研究，纳入41例接受直接PCI的STEMI患者，随机分为LIFU调控组（n=20）与假刺激组（n=21）；LIFU于导管室启动并延续至病房。随访7天，行动态心电图、血清生物标志物、超声心动图及安全性评估。主要终点为PCI后72小时内室性心律失常负荷，余为探索性终点；摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: LIFU显著降低PCI后72小时内室性心律失常负荷；心率变异性分析示低频功率及低频/高频比值降低；探索性分析示促炎细胞因子与交感神经递质水平更低；心肌损伤标志物两组无显著差异，第7天LIFU组LVEF更高；未观察到显著器官功能障碍或热损伤。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: LIFU调控左侧星状神经节可能抑制交感活性并减少STEMI直接PCI后室性心律失常，为首个支持其作为无创神经调控策略的临床证据；但样本量小、单中心、探索性设计，疗效与安全性需正在开展的多中心大样本试验（NCT07587294/ChiCTR2600122798）进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：交感神经过度激活可导致ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）后室性心律失常（VAs）。临床前研究表明，低强度聚焦超声（LIFU）调节左侧星状神经节（LSG）可减少STEMI后VAs。

目的：本研究旨在探讨LIFU调节LSG是否能减少STEMI患者直接经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）后的VAs。

方法：在这项单中心、前瞻性、随机、假刺激对照的探索性研究中，41例接受直接PCI的STEMI患者被分配至LIFU调节组（n = 20）或假刺激组（n = 21）。LIFU在导管室启动并在病房继续。所有患者随访7天，并接受动态心电图监测、血清生物标志物评估、超声心动图评估和安全性评估。

结果：LIFU显著减少了PCI后72小时内的VA负荷。心率变异性分析显示低频功率降低，低频/高频比值降低。探索性分析还显示促炎细胞因子和交感神经递质水平降低。心肌损伤标志物在两组间无显著差异，而LIFU组第7天左心室射血分数较高。此外，LIFU干预后未观察到显著的器官功能障碍或热损伤。

结论：LIFU调节LSG可能减弱接受PCI的STEMI患者的交感神经活性并减少VAs。本研究提供了首个临床证据，支持LIFU作为一种有前景的无创神经调节策略用于STEMI背景下VA的预防。需要更大规模的多中心试验（NCT07587294/ChiCTR2600122798，正在进行中）来证实这些发现。本研究为STEMI后VAs的管理提供了一种新策略。

title: Electrical Storm in Advanced Chagas Cardiomyopathy Treated With Stereotactic Arrhythmia Radiotherapy After LVAD Implantation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Refractory ventricular tachycardia (VT) in advanced Chagas cardiomyopathy remains challenging after prior ablation and mechanical circulatory support.

CASE SUMMARY: A 40-year-old man with advanced Chagas cardiomyopathy and prior endo-epicardial VT ablation developed electrical storm during influenza A infection and underwent left ventricular assist device implantation as a bridge to transplantation. Despite unloading, antiarrhythmic therapy, overdrive pacing, and stellate ganglion modulation, monomorphic VT persisted. Repeat ablation was unfavorable because of frailty and extensive residual lateral scar. Targeting for stereotactic arrhythmia radiotherapy (STAR) integrated late gadolinium enhancement cardiac magnetic resonance, clinical VT morphology, prior electroanatomic mapping, and planning computed tomography. A single 25-Gy fraction was delivered without acute complications. No sustained VT or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator shocks occurred during follow-up.

DISCUSSION: Multimodality-guided STAR was feasible in this critically ill left ventricular assist device-supported patient. Although stabilization cannot be attributed to STAR alone, radiotherapy was delivered without observed acute radiotherapy- or device-related complications.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: STAR may offer a noninvasive substrate-targeted option when repeat ablation is limited.

AI.tldr: 一例晚期恰加斯心肌病合并电风暴患者，在LVAD植入后仍反复室速，经多模态引导的立体定向心律失常放疗（STAR）后随访期内未再发生持续性室速或ICD放电。
AI.motivation: 晚期恰加斯心肌病患者的难治性室速在既往消融和机械循环支持后仍具挑战性，重复消融因患者虚弱和广泛瘢痕受限，需探索非侵入性基底靶向治疗选择。
AI.method: 病例报告。40岁男性晚期恰加斯心肌病患者，既往行心内膜-心外膜室速消融，因甲型流感感染诱发室风暴后植入左心室辅助装置（LVAD）作为移植桥接。尽管LVAD减负荷、抗心律失常药物、超速起搏及星状神经节调制，单形性室速仍持续。因虚弱和广泛残留侧壁瘢痕，重复消融不利。采用整合晚期钆增强心脏磁共振、临床室速形态、既往电解剖标测和计划CT的多模态引导，行单次25 Gy立体定向心律失常放疗（STAR）。
AI.result: 单次25 Gy STAR治疗顺利实施，无急性并发症。随访期间未发生持续性室速或植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）放电。摘要未报告具体随访时长及统计比较。
AI.conclusion: 多模态引导的STAR在LVAD支持的危重患者中可行，未观察到急性放疗或器械相关并发症。尽管病情稳定不能单独归因于STAR，但该技术为重复消融受限的难治性室速患者提供了非侵入性基底靶向选择。需进一步研究明确其疗效和安全性。

summary_zh:
背景：晚期恰加斯心肌病中的难治性室性心动过速（VT）在既往消融和机械循环支持后仍具有挑战性。

病例摘要：一名40岁男性，患有晚期恰加斯心肌病，既往接受过心内膜-心外膜VT消融，在甲型流感感染期间出现电风暴，并接受了左心室辅助装置植入作为移植桥接。尽管进行了心室卸载、抗心律失常治疗、超速起搏和星状神经节调节，单形性VT仍持续存在。由于虚弱和广泛的残留侧壁瘢痕，重复消融不利。立体定向心律失常放疗（STAR）的靶向整合了晚期钆增强心脏磁共振、临床VT形态、既往电解剖标测和计划计算机断层扫描。单次25 Gy分割剂量已交付，无急性并发症。随访期间未发生持续性VT或植入式心律转复除颤器电击。

讨论：多模态引导的STAR在这名危重的左心室辅助装置支持患者中是可行的。尽管稳定不能单独归因于STAR，但放疗已交付，未观察到急性放疗或设备相关并发症。

要点信息：当重复消融受限时，STAR可能提供一种非侵入性的基质靶向选择。

title: Cat eye syndrome chromosome region, candidate 1 is a novel prognostic biomarker in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
summary: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) exhibits great prognostic heterogeneity, necessitating the identification of high-risk patients for timely treatment. This study aimed to find novel prognostic biomarkers directly from diseased cardiac tissue to improve risk stratification of HCM. We utilized a myocardial transcriptome discovery cohort (n = 246; median follow-up 6.8 years) alongside two independent plasma validation cohorts (Beijing, n = 1,238; follow-up 2.5 years; Xi'an, n = 402; follow-up 4.8 years). The primary and secondary endpoints were cardiovascular death and sudden cardiac death (SCD), respectively. In the discovery cohort, myocardial expression of CECR1 (cat eye syndrome chromosome region, candidate 1, also known as ADA2, Adenosine Deaminase 2) demonstrated the strongest association with cardiovascular death (P = 9.6 × 10-5). Plasma CECR1 levels correlated modestly but significantly with myocardial expression. In the Beijing validation cohort, decreased plasma CECR1 predicted increased risks of cardiovascular death (adjusted hazard ratio (HR) 3.731, P < 0.001) and SCD (adjusted HR 7.398, P < 0.001), with areas under the curves (AUCs) of 0.720 and 0.798, respectively. These findings were replicated in the Xi'an validation cohort. Integrating plasma CECR1 into the HCM Risk-SCD model significantly enhanced its predictive performance, increasing the AUC from 0.723 to 0.845 (P = 0.031) in the Beijing validation cohort and consistently improving it from 0.600 to 0.781 (P = 0.018) in the Xi'an validation cohort. In conclusion, CECR1 represents a novel prognostic biomarker of HCM. Measurement of CECR1 may improve risk stratification by facilitating the identification of individuals at higher risk of cardiovascular mortality. CECR1 assessment may provide additional information for SCD risk evaluation and support clinical decision-making regarding implantable cardioverter-defibrillator therapy.

AI.tldr: 在肥厚型心肌病中，心肌和血浆CECR1水平降低与心血管死亡和心脏性猝死风险升高独立相关，将其加入HCM Risk-SCD模型可显著提升风险分层的预测效能。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）预后异质性大，现有风险分层工具（如HCM Risk-SCD模型）预测效能有限，亟需从病变心肌组织直接发现新型预后生物标志物，以识别高危患者并及时干预。
AI.method: 研究采用心肌转录组发现队列（n=246，中位随访6.8年）及两个独立血浆验证队列（北京队列n=1,238，随访2.5年；西安队列n=402，随访4.8年）。主要终点为心血管死亡，次要终点为心脏性猝死（SCD）。在发现队列中筛选与心血管死亡最强关联的基因，并在验证队列中检测血浆蛋白水平，采用Cox回归计算调整风险比（HR），以ROC曲线下面积（AUC）评估预测效能，并分析将血浆CECR1加入HCM Risk-SCD模型后的增量价值。
AI.result: 在发现队列中，心肌CECR1表达与心血管死亡的关联最强（P=9.6×10⁻⁵）。血浆CECR1水平与心肌表达呈中度但显著相关。在北京验证队列中，血浆CECR1降低预测心血管死亡风险升高（调整HR 3.731，P<0.001）和SCD风险升高（调整HR 7.398，P<0.001），AUC分别为0.720和0.798；上述结果在西安队列中得到重复。将血浆CECR1加入HCM Risk-SCD模型后，北京队列AUC从0.723提升至0.845（P=0.031），西安队列从0.600提升至0.781（P=0.018）。
AI.conclusion: CECR1是HCM的新型预后生物标志物，血浆CECR1检测有助于改善风险分层、识别心血管死亡高危个体，并为SCD风险评估及ICD治疗决策提供额外信息。本研究为观察性设计，CECR1的临床效用仍需前瞻性干预研究验证。

summary_zh: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）表现出很大的预后异质性，需要识别高危患者以及时治疗。本研究旨在直接从病变心脏组织中寻找新的预后生物标志物，以改善HCM的风险分层。我们利用了一个心肌转录组发现队列（n = 246；中位随访6.8年）以及两个独立的血浆验证队列（北京，n = 1,238；随访2.5年；西安，n = 402；随访4.8年）。主要终点和次要终点分别为心血管死亡和心脏性猝死（SCD）。在发现队列中，CECR1（猫眼综合征染色体区域候选基因1，也称为ADA2，腺苷脱氨酶2）的心肌表达与心血管死亡的关联最强（P = 9.6 × 10-5）。血浆CECR1水平与心肌表达呈适度但显著相关。在北京验证队列中，血浆CECR1降低预测心血管死亡风险增加（校正风险比（HR）3.731，P < 0.001）和SCD风险增加（校正HR 7.398，P < 0.001），曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.720和0.798。这些发现在西安验证队列中得到重复。将血浆CECR1整合到HCM Risk-SCD模型中显著提高了其预测性能，在北京验证队列中AUC从0.723增加到0.845（P = 0.031），在西安验证队列中一致地从0.600提高到0.781（P = 0.018）。总之，CECR1是HCM的一种新型预后生物标志物。测量CECR1可能通过促进识别心血管死亡风险较高的个体来改善风险分层。CECR1评估可能为SCD风险评估提供额外信息，并支持关于植入式心律转复除颤器治疗的临床决策。

title: Vagal maneuvers and pharmacological cardioversion in stable PSVT: A systematic review with implications for emergency nursing practice.
summary: Paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) is a common arrhythmic emergency for which vagal maneuvers offer a non-pharmacological route to cardioversion before drug escalation. This systematic review compared the effectiveness and safety of vagal maneuvers-particularly the standard and modified Valsalva maneuvers-against pharmacological cardioversion in adults with stable PSVT. Following PRISMA 2020 guidance, eleven studies published between 2014 and 2024 were identified across six databases and synthesized narratively owing to clinical and methodological heterogeneity. The modified Valsalva maneuver consistently achieved higher cardioversion rates than the standard technique and carotid sinus massage, with a favorable safety profile, while adenosine remained effective but more frequently associated with recurrence and discomfort. Effectiveness varied by age, arrhythmia subtype, and care setting. Collectively, the evidence supports the modified Valsalva maneuver as a safe, low-cost, first-line option before pharmacological escalation, with particular relevance to nurse-led management in emergency and prehospital care.

AI.tldr: 改良Valsalva动作在稳定PSVT成人中较标准Valsalva及颈动脉窦按摩转复率更高且安全，腺苷有效但复发和不适更多，支持其作为药物升级前一线选择。
AI.motivation: 阵发性室上性心动过速（PSVT）是常见心律失常急症，迷走动作可在药物升级前提供非药物转复路径，但迷走动作（尤其标准与改良Valsalva动作）与药物转复在稳定PSVT成人中的有效性和安全性比较证据尚需系统整合。
AI.method: 系统综述，遵循PRISMA 2020指南，检索6个数据库，纳入2014—2024年发表的11项研究；研究对象为稳定PSVT成人；比较迷走动作（标准与改良Valsalva动作、颈动脉窦按摩）与药物转复（腺苷等）；因临床与方法学异质性采用叙述性综合；主要终点为转复率，次要终点包括复发与不适等安全性指标。
AI.result: 改良Valsalva动作的转复率持续高于标准Valsalva动作和颈动脉窦按摩，且安全性良好；腺苷仍有效，但与更多复发和不适相关；有效性随年龄、心律失常亚型和诊疗环境而异。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据支持改良Valsalva动作作为稳定PSVT成人药物升级前的安全、低成本一线选择，尤其适用于急诊和院前由护士主导的管理；但受纳入研究异质性限制，结论需谨慎推广，具体效应量缺失。

summary_zh: 阵发性室上性心动过速（PSVT）是一种常见的心律失常急症，迷走神经手法为药物升级前的转复提供了一种非药物途径。本系统综述比较了迷走神经手法——尤其是标准Valsalva动作与改良Valsalva动作——与药物转复在成人稳定性PSVT中的有效性和安全性。遵循PRISMA 2020指南，在六个数据库中检索到2014年至2024年间发表的11项研究，并因临床和方法学异质性而进行叙述性综合。改良Valsalva动作的转复率始终高于标准技术和颈动脉窦按摩，且安全性良好，而腺苷仍然有效，但更常与复发和不适相关。有效性因年龄、心律失常亚型和诊疗环境而异。总体而言，证据支持改良Valsalva动作作为药物升级前安全、低成本的一线选择，尤其与急诊和院前护理中的护士主导管理相关。

title: Transjugular implantation of a leadless pacemaker in a 97-year-old patient with severe kyphosis and tortuous femoral veins: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Leadless pacemaker systems offer significant benefits for frail older adults by avoiding pocket- and lead-related complications. However, anatomical challenges including severe spinal deformities and significant venous tortuosity can complicate conventional transfemoral or trans-subclavian implantation.

CASE REPORT: A 97-year-old man with severe kyphosis, tortuous femoral veins, and high-grade atrioventricular block was referred for permanent pacing. Supine positioning for subclavian access was not feasible, and the femoral anatomy posed an unacceptably high procedural risk. Following a multidisciplinary assessment and procedural planning, a transjugular approach was selected. Implantation was performed with the patient in the left lateral decubitus position, using adapted fluoroscopic projections and temporary femoral pacing as backup. An Aveir ventricular response leadless pacemaker was successfully delivered via the right internal jugular vein. Final device parameters were satisfactory, with a sensing amplitude of 8.5 mV, a pacing threshold of 0.5 V at 0.4 ms, and an impedance of 510 Ω. No perioperative complications occurred. At follow-up, exertional dyspnea had resolved, and device performance remained stable.

CONCLUSION: This case demonstrates that transjugular implantation of a leadless pacemaker can be a safe and feasible alternative for older adults with complex anatomical limitations that contraindicate standard pacing approaches. Careful preprocedural assessment and adaptation of intraoperative techniques are essential for procedural success in high-risk settings.

summary_zh:
背景：无导线起搏器系统通过避免囊袋和导线相关并发症，为体弱的老年人提供了显著获益。然而，包括严重脊柱畸形和显著静脉迂曲在内的解剖学挑战，可能使常规的经股静脉或经锁骨下静脉植入变得复杂。

病例报告：一名97岁男性，患有严重脊柱后凸、股静脉迂曲和高度房室传导阻滞，被转诊接受永久起搏治疗。因无法平卧进行锁骨下静脉入路，且股静脉解剖结构带来了不可接受的高手术风险。经过多学科评估和手术规划，选择了经颈静脉入路。植入手术在患者左侧卧位下进行，采用调整后的透视投照角度，并以临时股静脉起搏作为备份。通过右侧颈内静脉成功植入了一枚Aveir心室应答无导线起搏器。最终器械参数令人满意，感知振幅为8.5 mV，起搏阈值在0.4 ms下为0.5 V，阻抗为510 Ω。未发生围手术期并发症。随访时，劳力性呼吸困难已缓解，器械性能保持稳定。

title: Atrial Leadless Pacing: A Potential Strategy for Cardioinhibitory Vasovagal Syncope.
summary: Cardioinhibitory vasovagal syncope (VVS) may be associated with prolonged sinus pauses and recurrent syncope despite conservative therapy or cardioneuroablation (CNA). Although permanent pacing may be considered in selected patients, the role of leadless pacing, particularly atrial leadless pacing, remains poorly established; however, it may represent a potential therapeutic option in carefully selected patients.

summary_zh: 心脏抑制型血管迷走性晕厥（VVS）可能与窦性停搏时间延长及反复晕厥相关，尽管已接受保守治疗或心脏神经消融（CNA）。虽然在部分经过选择的患者中可考虑永久起搏，但无导线起搏、尤其是心房无导线起搏的作用仍不明确；然而，在经过仔细选择的患者中，它可能是一种潜在的治疗选择。

title: Advances and challenges in personalized cardiac modeling and simulation for predicting the risk of sudden death from malignant arrhythmias in post-myocardial infarction.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) represents a major global public health challenge, with malignant ventricular arrhythmias being its primary cause. This review focuses specifically on post-myocardial infarction (post-MI) ischemic cardiomyopathy-the most prevalent substrate for malignant ventricular arrhythmias. Current clinical practice predominantly relies on single functional indices, such as left ventricular ejection fraction, for risk stratification. This approach suffers from significant limitations in predictive accuracy, leading to dilemmas in the prophylactic application of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, including both under-implantation and over-implantation. Personalized cardiac modeling and simulation technology, an advanced embodiment of the digital twin concept in cardiovascular medicine, offers a highly promising non-invasive solution to overcome these limitations. The core of this technology lies in the deep integration of personalized, multi-modal clinical imaging data, particularly late gadolinium enhancement sequences from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging. This enables the precise construction of individualized cardiac anatomical substrates that reflect the spatial distribution of myocardial fibrosis and scar. Building upon this anatomical foundation, multi-scale computational models are established, spanning from microscopic ion channel kinetics and cellular electrophysiological activity to macroscopic tissue conduction properties. These models systematically simulate core pro-arrhythmic factors under pathological conditions, including key ion channel remodeling, the coupling effects of non-myocytes, and alterations in anisotropic conduction properties of myocardial tissue. Ultimately, by implementing programmed electrical stimulation protocols on the computational heart model, the susceptibility to arrhythmias is dynamically assessed, achieving quantitative and visual stratification of an individual's SCD risk. This technological framework not only non-invasively reveals the dynamic electrical instability underlying static anatomical substrates but also demonstrates broad application prospects in understanding complex arrhythmia mechanisms, assisting in clinical therapeutic decision-making, and advancing the shift towards precision medicine models.

AI.tldr: 针对心肌梗死后恶性室性心律失常风险，基于LGE-CMR的个体化多尺度心脏建模与仿真可无创定量评估致心律失常易感性，有望弥补LVEF单一指标在ICD预防决策中的不足。
AI.motivation: 心梗后缺血性心肌病是恶性室性心律失常和SCD的最常见基质，当前临床仅依赖LVEF等单一功能指标进行风险分层，预测准确性有限，导致ICD预防性植入不足或过度植入的两难。个体化心脏建模与仿真作为数字孪生理念在心血管领域的应用，有望提供无创、精准的风险评估工具。
AI.method: 本文为综述，聚焦心梗后缺血性心肌病患者。系统梳理个体化心脏建模与仿真技术：以多模态临床影像（尤其心脏磁共振延迟钆增强序列）构建反映心肌纤维化与瘢痕空间分布的个体化解剖基质，建立从离子通道动力学、细胞电生理到组织传导特性的多尺度计算模型，模拟病理状态下离子通道重构、非心肌细胞耦联效应及各向异性传导改变等致心律失常因素，并在计算心脏上实施程序电刺激方案动态评估心律失常易感性。摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。综述性描述指出，该技术框架可无创揭示静态解剖基质背后的动态电不稳定性，实现个体化SCD风险的定量与可视化分层，并在理解复杂心律失常机制、辅助临床治疗决策及推动精准医学模式转变方面具有应用前景。
AI.conclusion: 个体化心脏建模与仿真为心梗后SCD风险分层提供了超越LVEF的无创定量新思路，有望优化ICD预防性植入决策。当前证据以综述性描述为主，缺乏前瞻性临床验证数据，其临床转化仍面临影像数据标准化、模型计算效率与可重复性等挑战，尚不能替代现有临床决策路径。

summary_zh: 心源性猝死（SCD）是一项重大的全球公共卫生挑战，恶性室性心律失常是其首要原因。本综述特别聚焦于心肌梗死后（post-MI）缺血性心肌病——这是恶性室性心律失常最常见的基质。当前临床实践主要依赖单一功能指标（如左心室射血分数）进行风险分层。该方法在预测准确性方面存在显著局限性，导致植入式心律转复除颤器预防性应用陷入困境，包括植入不足与植入过度。个性化心脏建模与仿真技术作为数字孪生概念在心血管医学中的高级体现，为克服这些局限性提供了一种极具前景的无创解决方案。该技术的核心在于深度整合个性化的多模态临床影像数据，尤其是心脏磁共振成像的晚期钆增强序列。这使得能够精确构建反映心肌纤维化与瘢痕空间分布的个体化心脏解剖基质。在此解剖学基础上，建立多尺度计算模型，涵盖从微观离子通道动力学与细胞电生理活动到宏观组织传导特性。这些模型系统模拟病理条件下的核心致心律失常因素，包括关键离子通道重构、非心肌细胞的耦合效应以及心肌组织各向异性传导特性的改变。最终，通过在计算心脏模型上实施程序电刺激方案，动态评估心律失常易感性，实现个体SCD风险的定量与可视化分层。该技术框架不仅无创地揭示静态解剖基质下潜在的动态电不稳定性，还在理解复杂心律失常机制、辅助临床治疗决策以及推动向精准医学模式转变方面展现出广阔的应用前景。
